text:
Maya: I opened a small PR to update SDK snippets after the recent API rename (stream_iter -> stream) and pagination token changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501

Ethan: Taking a look. Key changes: stream is async iterable, pagination uses opaque page_token, retries controlled via max_retries (default 3).

Priya: Quick reviewer checklist:
- py example shows async stream and resumable cursor
- ts uses for-await and fixed broken anchor
- go pager shows PageToken resume pattern and mentions built-in retries

Maya: Py snippet in PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
async for chunk in client.stream('gpt-small', prompt='short', max_retries=2):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```

Ethan: TS example uses async iterator:
```ts
for await (const p of client.stream('gpt-small', { prompt: 'short' })) { process.stdout.write(p.text); }
```
\
Priya: Go pager note added: use pager.PageToken() to resume and set ListOpts.PageToken on next call.

docs-bot: CI green for PR 501. Auto-linker fixed one outdated link.

Maya: Please add tiny runbook notes about retry defaults in PR description so support can triage.

Ethan: Added 1-line about default max_retries=3 and backoff jitter.

Priya: LGTM.

Maya: Merging if no objections.
